title: Adaptive Cruise Control Component Locations
introduction:
For vehicles with adaptive cruise control, this drawing connects component identity with general location. CPP means clutch pedal position, and CCM means cruise control module.

I start with the Item/Description table, match its entries to the circled callouts in the enlarged insets, then follow each leader line back to the transparent vehicle view. The insets show component shapes and mounting features; the faded bodywork lets you see where those components sit. It is a useful bit of automotive X-ray vision.

Use this reference for identification and location. Access, removal, connector orientation and electrical testing require their own instructions.
